properties.citation: G. P. Murdock, Africa: Its Peoples and Their Culture History, McGraw-Hill, 1959, « Tribal Map of Africa »; polygons digitised by Nathan Nunn (https://scholar.harvard.edu/nunn/pages/data-0, murdock_shapefile.zip); copy used: https://github.com/sboysel/murdock/blob/master/data-raw/Murdock_EA_2011_vkZ.geojson. Murdock's polygons ASHANTI, AKYEM, BRONG, FANTI, ASSINI and the Ghana part of ANYI; GA, ADELE and GUANG are left out.
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the research's polygon yk-akan-gha.geojson, kept inside the Natural Earth 1:50m polygon of Ghana (ADM0_A3 GHA) so its outer edge is the country's; on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped. Murdock's names are the colonial ethnonyms of 1959.
properties.licence: Geometry: G. P. Murdock (1959), digitised by Nathan Nunn.
